# Packing less clay equipment

Carried three tools to the pottery class and borrowed the rest. I spent less time arranging my table and more time looking at the rim. A constraint can help, but only because the shared cupboard is there. [[Pottery]]: do not turn my successful minimal kit into a rule for a person without access to the same room.
